children: ") today announced that the Board of Directors has approved the grant of an aggregate number of 975,000 incentive stock options to its officers and directors. The exercise price of the stock options granted is $0.13 per common share. Subject to the rules of the TSX Venture Exchange, including the four months plus one day exchange hold period, and the Company’s Stock Option Plan, the options vest immediately and have a term of ten years and will expire on September 3, 2036.

is a Canadian mineral exploration company exploring for critical minerals in Ontario, Canada. It has a prospective, nickel copper cobalt exploration portfolio, with its Montcalm project, which now covers approximately 104 km2 adjacent to Glencore’s former Montcalm Mine with historical production of 3.93 million tonnes of ore grading 1.25% Ni, 0.67% Cu and 0.051% Co (Ontario Geological Survey, Atkinson, 2010), as well as its 11 km2 Warren Ni Cu Co Project and its newly optioned Rankin Property. These complementary nickel copper cobalt projects have excellent road access and infrastructure and are in close proximity to the Timmins Mining Camp. The Company has 41,672,296 common shares outstanding.
